package.description: SanDisk Security tool to create, change and modify the password for SanDisk drives

en-US.description: SanDisk Security tool to create, change and modify the password for SanDisk drives
en-US.longDescription:
SanDisk Security features the ability to:

- Create a password to keep others from accessing the files on the drive
- Change the password
- Remove password protection
- Unlock drive

Supported Products:

SanDisk Extreme, Go, Pro, Creator Pro (E51, E61, E50, E52, E81, E81C)
